/ 01 — THE MISSION

Green claims need
ground truth.

“Sustainable” is easy to print on a product page. It is much harder to prove across farms, warehouses, and offset forests. SpaceSustain turns remote sensing signals into a transparent, reviewable shopping experience.

/ 04 — THE METHOD

Signals, not
spin.

Our prototype combines three observable Earth signals with declared supplier and facility locations. Scenario anomaly rules flag changes; a transparent scoring layer turns those flags into an explainable score.

01 / SOURCE

Vegetation health

Compare NDVI or forest cover change in declared sourcing zones using Sentinel-2 or Landsat imagery.

02 / FACILITY

Surface heat context

Compare land surface temperature and roof reflectance against nearby reference areas. Facility energy use needs separate data.

03 / OFFSET

Forest persistence

Use optical and radar time series to flag canopy loss or stalled growth. Carbon removal needs field and carbon accounting evidence.

Prototype boundaryThe current site uses scenario data and illustrative product records. The map can load an actual NASA imagery layer, but no brand, product, supplier, or offset has been independently verified.
